name: UI：环节参数详情-环节出参完整性及入参出参差集验证
description: 验证环节出参包含入参透传字段+环节新增计算字段(season_tag/style_tag)，且出参字段数≥入参字段数

steps.expression: (() => { const spans = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span')); const el = spans.find(s => (s.textContent || '').trim() === '入参'); if (!el) return { found: false }; const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, x: rect.x + rect.width/2, y: rect.y + rect.height/2 }; })()

steps.description: 打开环节参数详情弹窗

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const text = drawer.textContent || ''; // Define expected input params const inputParams = ['seller_id', 'seed_image_url', 'tao_cate', 'item_id', 'back_img_url', 'skc_img_url']; // Define expected output params (input passthrough + computed) const outputParams = ['seller_id', 'seed_image_url', 'season_tag', 'style_tag', 'item_id', 'tao_cate', 'back_img_url', 'skc_img_url']; // Find the '环节出参' section and extract its content const outputIdx = text.indexOf('环节出参'); const inputIdx = text.indexOf('入参取值配置'); const strategyIdx = text.indexOf('策略列表'); // Section boundaries const inputSection = text.substring(inputIdx >= 0 ? inputIdx : 0, strategyIdx >= 0 ? strategyIdx : text.length); const outputSection = text.substring(outputIdx >= 0 ? outputIdx : 0); // Check each param in sections const inputFound = inputParams.filter(p => inputSection.includes(p)); const outputFound = outputParams.filter(p => outputSection.includes(p)); // Computed fields = output only (not in input) const computedFields = outputParams.filter(p => !inputParams.includes(p)); const passthroughFields = outputParams.filter(p => inputParams.includes(p)); return { open: true, hasOutputSection: outputIdx >= 0, hasInputSection: inputIdx >= 0, hasStrategySection: strategyIdx >= 0, inputParamsExpected: inputParams.length, inputParamsFound: inputFound.length, inputParams: inputFound, outputParamsExpected: outputParams.length, outputParamsFound: outputFound.length, outputParams: outputFound, computedFields, computedFound: computedFields.filter(f => outputSection.includes(f)), passthroughFields, passthroughFound: passthroughFields.filter(f => outputSection.includes(f)), outputGteInput: outputFound.length >= inputFound.length }; })()

steps.description: 入参取值配置板块存在
出参字段数≥入参字段数(出参=入参透传+新增计算)
出参中至少1个新增计算字段(如season_tag/style_tag)
出参中至少4个入参透传字段

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); const btns = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('button')); const cancel = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('取')); if (!cancel) return { found: false }; const r = cancel.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, x: r.x + r.width/2, y: r.y + r.height/2 }; })()
